def cos_mat(X):
    Xn = X / np.linalg.norm(X, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return Xn @ Xn.T

def offdiag_mean(C):
    n = C.shape[0]
    return (C.sum() - np.trace(C)) / (n * (n - 1))
